feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi kasalukuyang listahan ang lumang sheet. Gamitin ang aprubadong lokal na listahan.
feedback_by_option.en: The old sheet is not the current list. Work from the approved local list.

feedback_by_option.fil: Itala ito, ihiwalay nang hindi ginagamit at iulat sa responsable sa palit.
feedback_by_option.en: Record it, set it aside unused and report it to the replacement owner.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Ang kasalukuyang lokal na listahan ang batayan ng bawat hanay na itatala mo.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. The current local list is the basis for every row you record.

feedback_by_option.fil: Iulat ang sirang gamit nang hindi ginagamit. Hindi sapat na mukhang malinis.
feedback_by_option.en: Escalate damaged items without using them. Looking clean is not the check.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Itinatala ang selyo, at iniuulat ang gamit nang hindi ginagamit.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. Package integrity goes on the sheet, and the item is escalated unused.

feedback_by_option.fil: Dapat kumpleto ang bawat hanay. Naitatago ng blangkong selyo ang problema.
feedback_by_option.en: Every row must be complete. A blank seal cell hides the problem.
